# Expert E-sign provider-agnostic TEST core

Private clinic service for administrator-operated iPad signing, immutable evidence storage and patient-copy delivery.

## Safety status

- exact 27-document package baseline: `COUNSEL_APPROVED_OWNER_CONFIRMED`
- patient-facing runtime templates: `NOT_EFFECTIVE` unless the canonical version registry contains an exact `IN_USE` row
- `NOT APPROVED FOR REAL PATIENT USE`
- Tunduk/OEP: deferred
- Automatic deletion: disabled
- Patient signing: authenticated administrator session only in hardened runtime

Legal wording authority: `docs/legal/raimov/expert-dental/package/markdown/` plus
`docs/legal/raimov/expert-dental/VERSION_REGISTRY.md`. The runtime registry is
generated by `npm run templates:write` and drift-checked by `npm run templates:check`.

Provider contract:

- `MockSignatureAdapter` — full synthetic E2E in TEST only;
- `ZohoSignAdapter` — disabled until approved vendor/API mapping and credentials exist;
- `DocuSignAdapter` — disabled fallback under the same gates.

SQNS remains the primary MIS/CRM. `lib/crm-contract.mjs` defines only stable
patient/visit/doctor/service references and the sealed-document callback; it
does not invent SQNS endpoints.

## Local synthetic run

```bash
cp .env.example .env
# Replace every secret and set ALLOW_COUNSEL_GATED_TEMPLATES=true only for synthetic test data.
docker compose --env-file .env \
  -f docker-compose.runtime.yml -f docker-compose.server.yml up -d --build
```

Open `http://localhost:8787/esign/`.

Do not use real medical data on a developer laptop.

## Runtime build

`Dockerfile.runtime` runs the reviewed `server.mjs` directly. TEST mode is
fail-closed to synthetic patient prefixes and disables outbound delivery.

## First boot

The deploy script creates a root-only bootstrap credential file. After first login:

1. create named doctor/administrator/compliance users;
2. configure MFA;
3. rotate/disable bootstrap credentials;
4. keep forms inactive until counsel/medical approval;
5. pair WAHA using an SSH tunnel to server loopback;
6. run synthetic acceptance tests;
7. verify backup/restore and Object Lock.

## Important endpoints

- `/healthz` — internal health;
- `/esign/` — staff/iPad PWA;
- `/esign/api/templates` — registry;
- `/esign/api/documents` — workflow;
- `/esign/api/sign/:code` — requires authorized administrator staff cookie in hardened runtime;
- `/esign/api/integration/crm/snapshot` — API-key protected SQNS-oriented
  patient/visit/doctor/service reference contract; no SQNS vendor endpoint is assumed;
- `/esign/webhooks/:provider` — raw-body signature verification, replay window and
  database-backed provider event idempotency.

## Evidence object set

```text
signed.pdf
signature-evidence.json
manifest.json
timestamp-rfc3161.tsr   # optional/provider dependent
```

All objects are versioned and put with Object Lock. A legal hold sets hold on every known object version.

## WAHA

WAHA is private. The API sends a short-lived internal HMAC URL to `/api/sendFile`; the patient receives a PDF, while the original remains in Object Lock storage.

## RFC 3161

The system can request and store an external detached timestamp. This is technical evidence, not a claim that the patient used a qualified KG digital signature.
